import csv
tsid='03f8d175-8f4f-5a5c-8017-4cac0978dde8'
rows=list(csv.reader(open(VALUES_CSV)))
data=[(r[1],float(r[2])) for r in rows[1:] if r[0]==tsid]
print(len(data))
day=[v for t,v in data if t.startswith('2018-07-14')]
rec_max=max(v for t,v in data)
print('record max',rec_max)
print('day max',max(day) if day else None)
print('ratio',max(day)/rec_max if day else None)
